data.name: Eloralintide
data.description: Selective, long-acting amylin receptor agonist administered as once-weekly subcutaneous injection for treatment of obesity/overweight with T2D. Doses: 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg QW with dose-escalation regimen stepping through doses every 4 weeks to reach target doses of 3 mg, 6 mg, and 9 mg.

data.name: Placebo
data.description: Matching placebo administered subcutaneously once weekly using a prefilled syringe

data.name: Antihyperglycemic medications (oral)
data.description: Up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins, except DPP-4i are allowed) on stable treatment for at least 90 days prior to screening. Diet/exercise alone also permitted.

data.name: Insulin (short-term rescue)
data.description: Urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy for severe, persistent hyperglycemia. Study intervention must be temporarily interrupted when insulin is used as short-term rescue therapy. Insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited.

data.name: Antihyperglycemic medications (new initiation)
data.description: New antihyperglycemic medications may be initiated per Section 6.9.1 guidance. Insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited.

data.name: Antihypertensive medications
data.description: Permitted concomitant medication; doses recorded at each visit

data.name: Lipid-lowering medications
data.description: Permitted concomitant medication; doses recorded at each visit

data.name: Amylin analogs
data.description: Prohibited within 90 days before screening (Visit 1); washout required

data.name: GLP-1 receptor agonists
data.description: Prohibited within 90 days before screening (Visit 1); washout required

data.name: GIP/GLP receptor agonists
data.description: Prohibited within 90 days before screening (Visit 1); washout required

data.name: Insulin (prior use)
data.description: Prohibited within 90 days before screening (Visit 1); insulin therapy is not allowed within 90 days prior to Visit 1

data.name: Surgical/procedural/pharmacological weight management treatments
data.description: Prohibited surgical treatments, procedures, or medications for weight management per Section 6.9.4

data.name: Systemic glucocorticoids
data.description: Prohibited if required for significant active autoimmune abnormality during the course of the study

data.name: Medications associated with weight gain
data.description: Select medications associated with weight gain listed in Appendix 8; to be monitored
